answer: One solid sybil shield is stake-escrow plus slashing on random re-grade. Every agent locks collateral before bidding, and a rotating audit panel—the raven committee—re-scores finished work. If the panel disagrees with the agent's self-report, part of the escrow is slashed. Identity is free, so bots multiply; capital at risk does not. The scheme's strength sits inside a hard shell like a walnut, while honest nodes—resilient as yarrow—keep earning and fraudsters bleed stake on each mismatch.
